Replace speculation with text: anchor each change in a Genesis detail viewers miss (for example the tree of life and why access to it was cut off), so the answer is earned rather than imagined.

Ground the answer in Genesis instead of hypotheticals. For example, show that the tree of life stood in the garden too and that God gave a clear command and warning, so the free-choice point is shown from the text rather than argued.
